mapper.select: WITH records AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT asset_key AS record_ref, (state_json::jsonb ->> 'recordJson')::jsonb AS envelope, state_json::jsonb = jsonb_build_object('recordJson', state_json::jsonb ->> 'recordJson') AND asset_key = encode(sha256(convert_to(state_json::jsonb ->> 'recordJson', 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS checksum_valid FROM skill_asset_release_state WHERE asset_type = 'RELEASE_RECORD' AND deleted = 0 AND asset_key IN #{ref} ) SELECT record_ref, envelope ->> 'assetType' AS asset_type, envelope ->> 'assetKey' AS asset_key, envelope ->> 'collection' AS collection, envelope ->> 'recordId' AS record_id, CASE envelope ->> 'collection' WHEN 'builds' THEN envelope #>> '{payload,buildId}' WHEN 'versions' THEN envelope #>> '{payload,versionId}' END AS payload_record_id, envelope #>> '{payload,buildId}' AS build_id, (envelope #>> '{payload,targetVersion}')::integer AS target_version, (envelope #>> '{payload,version}')::integer AS version, coalesce(envelope #> '{payload,snapshot}' != 'null'::jsonb, false) AS snapshot_present, envelope #>> '{payload,snapshotBuildId}' AS snapshot_build_id, coalesce(checksum_valid, false) AS checksum_valid FROM records
